scout.description: Finds local and online context. Reports relevant facts, files, sources, risks, and suggested next steps.

oracle.description: Advises on plans, architecture, sequencing, tradeoffs, alternatives, and risks.

executor.description: Implements the approved plan with minimal pragmatic changes and reports changed files, validation, and risks.

reviewer.description: Reviews plans or diffs for correctness, missed requirements, test gaps, maintainability risks, and actionable findings.
